nodes.label: Local-first Processing
nodes.rationale: Developer payloads and tokens are processed in the browser so pasted content is not sent to a server.

nodes.label: Indexable Prerendering
nodes.rationale: Each tool is prerendered as a real route with route-specific metadata so search engines can rank it and the static page matches the live React view.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Cache Policy
nodes.rationale: HTML is edge-cached for speed but purged on deploy, while hashed assets are immutable and retained so stale pages do not request missing chunks.

nodes.label: Chunk Compatibility Recovery
nodes.rationale: Previous hashed chunks are retained and a failed chunk load triggers one guarded reload, preventing blank pages during CDN deployment transitions.

nodes.label: Analytics Data Minimization
nodes.rationale: Analytics excludes site search and form interactions, and tool input is not placed in site URLs; outbound clicked URLs remain an explicitly documented exception.

nodes.label: Asset Load Recovery
nodes.rationale: An entry page whose hashed assets have been removed reloads once, with a session-storage cooldown to prevent a reload loop.

nodes.label: Release Asset Retention
nodes.rationale: The workflow carries a live release's hashed chunks forward so open tabs and cached HTML from the preceding release do not 404.
